sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic BimodalLib theorem registry design
sapience_notes.value: A registered theorem is a definition of type BimodalLib.TheoremEntry built by register_theorem from the type of the declaration (proof field cites the declaration; profile_eq closed by rfl). The registry is the set of constants of that type; no attribute and no environment extension, because extension rows pass no kernel check. assert_registry_complete scans by declaring module and must run in a module importing the root FormalSystem.

sapience_notes.subject: Lean 4 core reprove command (v4.33.0-rc1)
sapience_notes.value: Lean core already has a command keyword and syntax kind named reprove (reprove thm by tac). A user syntax declared with (name := reprove) fails to parse; a differently named node kind with surface syntax 'reprove X as Y := t' coexists with it.

sapience_notes.subject: Pairing a re-proof via a def macro in Lean 4
sapience_notes.value: Expanding a pairing command to 'def Y : type_of% @X := t' is unsafe for a registry: a def whose body fails to elaborate is still added with a sorry body, so a follow-up row would cite it. Elaborating t against the type of X with Term.withoutErrToSorry and adding the declaration directly makes a drifted proof declare nothing.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic closed-derivation census under FormalSystem/Theorems
sapience_notes.value: Measured by assert_registry_complete under import FormalSystem: 190 closed derivations (Boolean/Base 39, ModalBoolean/Base 25, ModalTemporalBoolean/Base 29, TemporalBoolean Base 81, ZTime 14, Dense 1, RTime 1), 85 context-form derivations, 56 rules. Under import FormalSystem.Theorems alone the context-form count is 19.

sapience_notes.subject: git-commit-scoped.sh file_scope containment in BimodalLogic
sapience_notes.value: With --task, git-commit-scoped.sh drops any pathspec outside the task's declared file_scope, commits the rest and exits 7. In the BimodalLib task this dropped a directory README that readme-lint.sh requires (file_scope named Registry/Complete.lean but not its directory) and two scripts/ edits. A declared file_scope should name the directory of every new .lean file, since readme-lint.sh requires a README beside each.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic scripts/verify-all.sh baseline and cost
sapience_notes.value: A full run takes about 10 minutes, almost all in check-evidence-probes.sh. On 2026-11-23 it failed three checks independent of the BimodalLib work: check-module-invariants.sh (C12, C20), readme-lint.sh (4 new stale dates under FormalSystem/), check-paper-definitions.sh. It now expects ten checks; the tenth is scripts/library-index.sh --check.

sapience_notes.subject: Harness foreground limit for long commands in this environment
sapience_notes.value: A foreground Bash call was moved to the background by the harness after 180 seconds regardless of the timeout parameter, so a bounded kill -0 waiter longer than that does not block in one call. Polling a result file in waits under about 170 seconds worked.
